items.reason: Modules, layers and quotes were re-verified against method and experiment sections.

O-D optimization takes 16-hour count data with an hour dimension, and ChatZero controls signals from per-step vehicle counts, evaluated by ATT/throughput; time-indexed observations are an input and an agent runtime is used, so the R0 scope_test is met, though weakly.

items.reason: ATT and throughput measure the consequence of control actions in simulation (policy utility), not output accuracy; API error rates are process validity.

adjudication.summary: Haiku candidate retained with the evaluation evidence reclassified: control ATT/throughput is decision utility, API error rates are process validity. Scope is borderline but supported by the O-D count-series and per-step vehicle-count inputs.
